#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>

int
LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)
{
    if (size < 50)
        return 0;

        char filename[256];
        sprintf(filename, "/tmp/libfuzzer.%d", getpid());

        FILE *fp = fopen(filename, "wb");
        if (!fp)
                        return 0;
        fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);
        fclose(fp);

        // Fuzz the cfg parser
        readcfgfile(filename);

        unlink(filename);

        return 0;
}
